description:
"That's ridiculous..." "To think I killed someone..." Ji-eun, Seong-min, So-young, and the three of So-young, who were classmates from the same university, drinking and playing in their studio apartment. Jieun, who fell asleep first, woke up to a loud noise. What she discovered was Seongmin trying to rape Soyoung! However, after failing to rape due to stubborn resistance, he eventually kills Soyoung... Panicked, Sungmin even imprisons Jieun.
